summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered direct offering of up to $15,958,000 of Class A common stock to YA II PN, Ltd. (Yorkville) under a Pre-Paid Advance Agreement dated June 11, 2026. Yorkville pays $15,958,000 less a 6% discount ($15,000,520 net), with shares issued at the lower of 130% of the prior day's VWAP (Fixed Price) or 90% of the five-day lowest VWAP (Market Price) subject to a $0.10 floor. Interest accrues at 4% (18% default). The filing is an ordinary at-the-market equity line facility, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisors are named. Watch for dilution and variable pricing mechanics typical of such financings.
